explication: Radar is a Kubernetes UI and API server that runs locally or in-cluster. Users open the web UI, choose a cluster/context and inspect live resources; the server accesses the Kubernetes API and streams updates to the browser. The product also exposes distinct GitOps, Helm, traffic, cost, audit, upgrade-impact, timeline, and MCP capabilities. The graph combines README-documented behavior with relationships visible in the supplied source index and excerpts; unsampled feature internals are represented at their existing directories, without assuming their call paths.
